meta.description:
Visiting the Giant Lady Buddha at Linh Ung Pagoda | Da Nang, Vietnam 🇻🇳

In this video we visited Linh Ung Pagoda on Son Tra Peninsula in Da Nang, home to the famous 67-meter Lady Buddha statue, one of the most impressive landmarks in the city. The temple is beautifully maintained and offers amazing views over Da Nang, the coastline, and the surrounding mountains.

This is definitely one of the must-visit places in Da Nang, especially if you want a mix of culture, beautiful scenery, and one of the most iconic viewpoints in the city.

We got here by Grab from our hotel, Hilton Garden Inn Da Nang, and the ride cost us 104,000 VND, which was super easy and convenient.

📍 Address: Linh Ung Pagoda, Bai But, Son Tra Peninsula, Da Nang, Vietnam 
🕒 Hours: Daily, 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM 
🎟️ Admission: Free

If you’re planning a trip to Da Nang, I highly recommend adding this place to your itinerary.

Thank you so much for watching and traveling with us! ❤️
